text:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT → canary-us-west-2: elevated 5xx rate (5.8%) across frontend gateway for the past 12m. Trigger: canary-policy-v2.
alice: seeing the alert, I'm on it. can someone grab logs and confirm error class?
ben: pulling logs from gateway pods now. some 503s + 524s. stack shows kv-cache evict & OOM spikes on quantized-worker replicas.
chas: customer-impact: a small subset of traffic routed to canary; a few customers report timeouts in their dashboards. severity P2 for now.
dana: oncall SRE here, pinging into the canary rollout. what's the current traffic weight?
alice: canary weight 10% for wave A. deploy-bot: rollout: canary-wave-A -> 10% at 2026-03-17T15:30Z, model: gptq-v2-8bit.
ben: repro command I ran: `kubectl logs -l app=quantized-worker -n inference --tail 200 | grep OOM` shows repeated OOMKilled events around 15:38Z. also see `kubelet eviction` messages.
dana: ok. immediate mitigation: abort canary and shift traffic to baseline. can we trigger feature-flag kill?
alice: I'm toggling flag `gate.canary_wave_a` to false now. `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"gate.canary_wave_a","value":false}'`
deploy-bot: feature flag `gate.canary_wave_a` set to false by alice at 15:40Z. Traffic shift initiated.
incident-bot: ROUTING CHANGE → canary->baseline reroute started. expected completion ~30s.
chas: notifying impacted customers: chas -> outreach queue with template. minimal API error window ~10-15m; advising retry.
ben: after flag flip, 5xx rate dropping in the gateway metrics. still seeing a few residual 5xx from connection resets.
dana: will scale down quantized-worker replicas for now and isolate the build that triggered OOMs. `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deploy/quantized-worker` executed.
alice: starting canary rollback in the deploy console too (reverting to previous image tag). deploy-bot: rollback job queued.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED -> reverting canary deploy to image=redwood/runtime:v1.23.4-rc3 -> target applied. ETA 90s.
ben: adding kernel logs and memory cgroup dumps to the incident thread gist: https://internal.gists/abc123 (followup for postmortem).
dana: handing off to ben for postmortem and to alice for customer comms. dana: I remain on pager for 30m to monitor. :white_check_mark:
alice: confirmed customers notified, incident timeline in progress.
chas: adding note: no SLA breach expected; monitoring for any recurrence.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS → mitigated (routing reverted, errors trending to baseline). Ticket created: INC-2026-342.
ben: will capture root cause candidate: quantized memory regression introduced in model packaging script; will open PR to revert packaging change.
alice: thanks team. logging timeline and next steps to the incident doc. good handoff.
dana: thanks, closing active pager. will escalate if anything spikes again. :raised_hands:
